decision.adaptive_budget: no separately validated recall-safe adaptive policy exists for these models; fixed B35/B50/B60 only

blind.custodian: a session separate from the training/selection side runs the frozen evidence protocol (tools/segarecomp_genesis_evidence.py run-title, plan 03ebc8f8...) on each reserved title into <corpus>/blind/<B077-xx>/ (identity checked against the pinned cohort); its labels are read only by blind-table after blind-score, which itself requires the committed models.json
blind.exposure: the custodian prepares blind labels under the frozen evidence protocol (plan 03ebc8f8...) in a sealed directory; the evaluator scores only after tools/segarecomp_seg077.models.json is committed; no change after exposure
blind.metrics: per title, on labelled cells only (positive: any I; negative: all D; masked cells excluded from both numerator and denominator): labelled ER = (labelled cells ranked at or above the weakest labelled positive, ties counted - labelled positives) / labelled negatives; plus B35/B50/B60 misses of labelled positive cells under the full-image ranking (segarecomp_ml_v3 fixed budgets); a title is informative when it has >= 50 labelled positive and >= 50 labelled negative cells; incomplete truth is reported as incomplete (no full-image recall is claimed)
blind.models: A_K1, B_K1 3-seed ensemble, CV2_K1 3-seed ensemble (all fits); comparators A_K0, B_K0, CV2_K0 (SEG-076's all fits plus the matching K0 seeds 2-3); the production M3_FROZEN path is bound to the SEG-072 registry images and is not run on the blind cohort

classes_precedence: LABEL_TRUTH_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 4 informative blind titles
DATA_INSUFFICIENT: fewer than 4 qualified new development lineages (the SEG-077 data hypothesis cannot be tested); the model comparison is still run and reported descriptively
ECONOMICS_NOT_JUSTIFIED: a neural advantage exists but the measured economics (SEG-076 C5 bench, unchanged) do not show >= 10% lower generated C or compile CPU than A at equal recall
C_ADVANTAGE / B_ADVANTAGE: a neural advantage (if both, the lower blind mean labelled ER; within 0.005 -> EQUIVALENT_WITH_COST_DIFFERENCE)
EQUIVALENT_WITH_COST_DIFFERENCE: no advantage either way and, for at least one neural model, |blind delta| < 0.01 and |development delta| < 0.005

development_classes_per_model.definition: paired lineage differences d_L = ER_K1(L) - ER_K0(L) over the 11 Genesis lineages, ER(L) = the lineage's maximum image ER (SEG-075 definition; the Genesis 'mean ER' is the mean of these over lineages); B and C-v2 on the 3-seed word-logit-mean ensemble, cell max at 128 bytes; mean d and the exact sign-flip p (two-sided)

decision.economics: measured (SEG-076 C5 bench, unchanged, 11 SEG-074 gate images) for (a) every model with a neural advantage and (b) every K1 model whose development mean ER beats A_K0 (SEG-076 A) by >= 0.01; otherwise classified 'not measured: no development retention advantage at verified full recall'; an unmeasured winner never receives economic credit
decision.learning_curve: 4/8/12/16-game checkpoints are infeasible: SEG-077-T002 bound STOP and exactly one new lineage qualified
decision.neural_advantage: model X in {B, CV2} (K1 ensemble) beats A_K1 when ALL hold: blind mean labelled ER over informative titles lower by >= 0.01; lower on >= 75% of informative titles; blind B50 misses not greater; development mean ER lower by >= 0.005 with sign-flip p <= 0.05 over the 11 lineages; and each of its 3 seeds alone has development mean ER below A_K1's

graph_integrity: C-v2 candidate edges and the PROVEN flag come from CPU-owned decode tokens, instruction words and the label-free seed roots only (segarecomp_xplat_models.window_graph, unchanged); tests/segarecomp_seg077_test.py proves that A features, the C graph and seeds are invariant to classes.bin
partial_labels: masked cells (-1) never enter any loss (A: labels >= 0; B/C: word labels >= 0); the M4 lineage-uniform sampler gives a mostly-masked lineage 1/12 of the windows, some of which carry no loss (frozen recipe, disclosed)

preflight.what: bounded 150-step probes on the K1 D05 training set (preflight; no scores kept)

resources.basis: SEG-076 measured costs (B ROCm ~7 min, C-v2 ROCm ~26 min per 4000-step fit, 3 parallel C-v2 fits); the caps are >= 5x B and ~6x C-v2; the T005 runtime preflight (recorded in the plan) confirms them on K1 before the matrix
resources.guard: when MemAvailable < floor the MOST RECENTLY started fit is killed (SEG-076 practice) and recorded host_memory_guard
resources.infra_rerun: exactly one identical re-run (recorded as attempt 2) after host_memory_guard, a signal kill, or 'interrupted' (a persisted 'started' job found at farm start after a host crash); never after timeout, rss_limit or a model error
resources.missing_fits: a configuration with any failed fit is INCOMPLETE: its ensemble and development class are not computed (reported INCOMPLETE); a missing K1 all-fit model is excluded from the blind evaluation; if A_K1 is missing, the final class is decided by precedence steps 1-2 only and otherwise recorded as INCOMPLETE_BASELINE; a failed reuse check means K0 = INCOMPLETE (no silent refit)
resources.phases: all CPU (A) jobs first (at most 4 at once), then the GPU (B, C-v2) jobs (at most 3 at once, starts staggered); the two groups never overlap

reuse: K0 SEG-076 arrays and all-fit weights are admitted only when `reuse` refits A.K0.D05, B.K0.D05.s1 and CV2.K0.D05.s1 under this plan and all three are bitwise identical to the SEG-076 arrays (SEG-076 precedent: D05 is the determinism sentinel; C-v2 seeds 2-3 and the all weights are covered by the same environment identity, not by their own refit); otherwise K0 is INCOMPLETE and any K0 refit requires a recorded amendment
seeds_policy: commercial images: reset-vector cell from the header only (label-free); Genesis images: SEG-072 registry seeds
status: frozen before the first SEG-077 fit and before any blind exposure
